tools.name: get-chapter
tools.description: Get full chapter content with all verses/hadiths (e.g., a surah from Quran, a chapter from hadith collection)

tools.name: get-part
tools.description: Get a specific hadith or part by number from a chapter (for non-Quran books like Bukhari, Muslim)

tools.name: get-verse
tools.description: Get a specific verse from a Quran surah

tools.name: list-books
tools.description: List all available books and collections (Quran, hadith collections, tafsirs) with localized names

tools.name: list-chapters
tools.description: List all chapters for a given book (e.g., surahs for Quran, books for hadith collections)

tools.name: search-content
tools.description: Full-text search across all Islamic content (Quran, hadith, tafsir)
